text:
Aisha: Quick thread — Saphire Health incident closed. Before I send account update, need confirmation on action items+owners. Summary: fallback routing triggered x3; p95 latency increased to 180ms during window; unexpected rate-limited retrys leading to billing spikes. Who owns postmortem, and who will reach out to customer?

Jorge: I'll own the postmortem writeup. Need logs for 2026-03-18 22:00 -> 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC. @Devon can you pull the routing / cache metrics? :mag:

Devon: Pulling now. Query I ran:
```
SELECT ts, route, kv_cache_hit, latency_ms
FROM inference_metrics
WHERE account_id='saphire' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-18T22:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-19T02:00:00Z'
```
Prelim: kv_cache_hit ~42%, a few spikes where hit dropped to 5% during region failover. Patch to routing policy queued (cfg id rpol-87). ETA 2h.

incident-bot: incident-2026-03-19-12345 status changed to RESOLVED by Jorge at 2026-03-19T03:05:12Z

Maya: I'll schedule a customer call for Mon 10am PT and prepare a short RCA deck + action plan. Proposing to offer a one-time usage credit; thoughts?

Ethan: I'd prefer confirming root cause window before committing credits. Happy to join the customer call to explain mitigations.

Leah: I'll take the CS tracker entry and add assignees + deadlines. Placeholder link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-987 (will update with doc)

Aisha: Thanks — temporary checklist:
1) Jorge — postmortem writeup (due Tue 18:00 PT)
2) Devon — routing patch + validation (deploy to canary and report back, ETA 2h)
3) Maya — customer call + draft credit proposal (Mon 10am PT)
4) Leah — CS tracker entry + update account health score
5) Ethan — join call + approve credit if needed
I'll send the account update after Jorge attaches the final RCA. :white_check_mark:

Jorge: noted and started the writeup. Will ping when doc ready.

Devon: canary patch deployed to us-west-canary. No regression in perf after 30m smoke. Will monitor for 6h.

Maya: call scheduled and invite sent to customer & core team. Invite: Mon 2026-03-22 10:00 PT.

Leah: CS tracker updated: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-987/1 — assigned per checklist.

Aisha: Closing loop here — if nothing else, I'll post the update to Saphire in the morning and link the RCA. :raised_hands:
